dhp167:1: One should not follow a life of evil, one should not dwell together with heedlessness,
dhp167:3: One should not follow false views, one should not look with high regard upon the world.
dhp168:1: A man should exert himself, and should not live the life of Heedlessness.
dhp168:2: A man should live righteously; for by living righteously
dhp168:3: A man rests happily, both in this world and in the next.
dhp169:1: A man should live righteously, not unrighteously;
dhp169:3: For by living righteously a man rests happily, both in this world and in the next.
dhp170:1: As a bubble, as a mirage, so should one view the world;
dhp170:3: If a man so look upon the world, the King of Death sees him not.
dhp171:1: Come, look upon this world; it resembles the gaudy chariot of a king;
dhp171:3: In it simpletons sink down, but the discerning cherish no attachment for it.
dhp172:1: He who, heedless before, heedless is no more,
dhp172:3: Illumines this world as does the moon freed from a cloud.
dhp173:1: He whose past misdeeds are covered by good deeds,
dhp173:3: Illumines this world as does the moon freed from a cloud.
dhp174:1: Blind is this world; few are there here that see;
dhp174:3: As few go to heaven as birds escape from a net.
dhp175:1: Swans follow the track of the sun; they that possess magical power go through the air;
dhp175:3: The resolute are conducted out of this world, having conquered Māra and his train.
dhp176:1: If a man break one commandment, if he speak lies,
dhp176:3: If he abandon the next world, there is no evil deed he will not commit.
dhp177:1: The niggardly go not to the World of the Gods; simpletons applaud not almsgiving;
dhp177:3: But the wise man applauds almsgiving, and therefore wins happiness in the world beyond.
dhp178:1: In comparison with sovereignty over the earth, in comparison with going to heaven,
dhp178:3: In comparison with supremacy over all the worlds, the Fruit of Conversion is of supreme excellence.
